sales_csv.description: Daily sales export (CSV on a file share or any HTTPS URL)

erp_sql.description: ERP reporting database (use a READ-ONLY login)

queries.orders_by_day: SELECT CAST(OrderDate AS date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM dbo.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(day,-30,GETDATE()) GROUP BY CAST(OrderDate AS date)
queries.top_customers: SELECT TOP 20 Customer, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY revenue DESC

hr_oracle.description: HR Oracle database (use a READ-ONLY account)

queries.headcount: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS people FROM employees GROUP BY department

pp_flow.description: Power Automate flow wrapping the SQL Server / Oracle / Excel Online connectors (works through the on-premises data gateway)
